links.comparator_used: Same LLMs prompted without the rule set of institutional category definitions
links.outcome: Macro-averaged F1 for primary imaging finding
links.effect: Biomedical model improved with the rule set (difference, 0.23; 95% CI, 0.11-0.33); no model was significantly worse with it
links.quote: A rule set stating institutional category definitions improved the biomedical model (difference, 0.23; 95% CI, 0.11-0.33) without significantly reducing performance in any model, whereas biomedical fine-tuning conferred no advantage over the control model and example retrieval did not help.
